g.text: Spectracs — Android deployment architecture (K2: real scipy in-app · two APKs) · DESIGN 2026-07-02
DEFERRED — real-hardware capture (Phase 7; not in first target)
ROI → peaks → calibrate → spectrum → colour → verdict
APKs, isolated sandboxes ⇒ two separate DBs.
Fully local showcase — no reliance on a public (sciens.at) service.
Deferred: no device available now, and the RPi tier
could carry capture (and heavy compute) over the network,
making OTG unnecessary. Decide UVC-over-OTG vs RPi then.
: raw buildozer + python-for-android (NOT pyside6-android-deploy — it can't do
services / a 2nd app / custom recipes). Chaquopy rejected (not a Qt runtime).
: p4a scipy recipe = Meson + OpenBLAS + flang. scipy 1.18 removed all its
: a minimal PySide6+scipy APK on a real phone must prove
+ find_peaks/svd run under the PySide6 runtime (no public precedent yet).
